in_marathi.name: Vaibhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vaibhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Vaibhan was the divine treasurer of Indra, the king of gods. His name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vaibhava', meaning 'manifestation' or 'divine form'.

vedic_reference.note: Vaibhan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'वै' (Vai) meaning 'all' and 'भन्' (Bhan) meaning 'to speak'. It can be translated as 'speaker of all' or 'one who speaks all'. It is not directly derived from any specific Vedic text or mythology.
